text: The City-led Update Downsview Study commenced in Fall 2021, and established a comprehensive planning framework for the Downsview area to help guide the development of resilient, sustainable and equitable complete communities over the next 30 years, including the Downsview Secondary Plan, Urban Design Guidelines, Master Environmental Servicing Plan and Community Development Plan. Initiated by the closure of the Downsview Airport and combined with other redevelopment opportunities, it is estimated that the Secondary Plan Area will accommodate 115,000 new residents and 52,000 workers over the next 30 years. This represents one of the largest and most transformative city-building efforts in the history of Toronto.
